title: Annual Spring Carnival & Community Open House
summary: Join our biggest family celebration of the season with interactive sensory stalls, live puppet theatre, bouncy castles, and campus tours with our teachers.
description: Our Annual Spring Carnival brings together our entire school community for a day of joyful celebration, creative exploration, and family bonding. Experience live music, balloon crafting, organic snack stations, and meet our passionate educators in person.

schedule.details: Registration badge pick-up and welcome drinks
Engaging interactive storytelling by guest puppeteers
Safe physical challenges for toddlers and kindergarteners
Healthy snacks, fruit skewers, and prizes
